title: Plata y oro
goal: Read how one Andean mountain funded a global empire: a boomtown that rivaled London, a toxic extraction method, and coins that circulated as far as Ming China.

items: Explain what was discovered at Potosí in 1545 and why it mattered.
Explain what caused the sharpest demographic decline near Potosí.
Describe the 'proceso de patio' and its cost to workers.
State roughly how large Potosí's population grew, and what that's comparable to.
Use passive voice to trace silver's journey from mine to global currency.
